title: PSE&G Rebates 2026: Heat Pump, Water Heater, Battery, Appliances
desc: What PSE&G pays New Jersey homeowners in 2026: heat pumps up to $10,000, water heater $450 to $750, GridSmart battery up to $5,000, appliance rebates, free assessments and interest-free repayment.
lead: PSE&G is New Jersey's largest utility, serving cities such as Newark and Jersey City. It runs a large set of rebates through its HVAC Instant Rebates Program, its appliance store, a home battery program and free assessments. Amounts change by what you replace and how much you earn. These are the 2026 figures from PSE&G's own pages, read on October 6, 2026.
cards_intro: PSE&G says all programs are subject to change, including ending, without notice. Each card names the fact with the date and source link.

cards.title: Standard heat pump instant rebate
cards.note: $300 or $450 by efficiency tier, and $600 for a cold climate model. Applied as a deduction on the contractor's invoice.

cards.title: Clean Heat: replace gas, oil or propane
cards.note: Lesser of $10,000 or 50% of the project; income-qualified lesser of $12,000 or 60%. Plus up to $2,000 each for removing the old system and for new ducts, and $2,000 for each extra cold climate heat pump.

cards.title: Dual fuel and hybrid
cards.note: Keep the old furnace or boiler as backup. Control unit rebates up to $1,500 each, two per home.

cards.title: Ground source heat pump
cards.note: Lesser of $3,000 per 10,000 BTUH or 50% for gas homes, and $4,000 per 10,000 BTUH or 50% for delivered fuel homes.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: $750 when replacing a fossil fuel water heater, $450 on the standard list.

cards.title: Income-qualified bonus
cards.note: Added to HVAC instant rebates for incomes at or below 400% of poverty, moderate-income areas or safety-net benefits.

cards.title: Appliance rebates
cards.note: Induction cooktop $250, electric dryer up to $300, washer up to $100, refrigerator up to $100, dishwasher $30, plus instant discounts.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: Free with a Whole Home Energy Assessment.

cards.title: GridSmart Battery Program
cards.note: Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase 10C and Enphase 5P. New installs only.

cards.title: On-bill repayment
cards.note: Interest-free repayment on your PSE&G bill, over 84 or 120 months.

cards.title: Home Weatherization and assessment
cards.note: A one-hour assessment with free products, and free insulation work for moderate incomes.

cards.title: EV home charger
cards.note: Charger setup help, plus up to $5,000 off a required deposit for utility work. The off-peak charging credit is discontinued.

sections: PSE&G's official territory list shows Newark in Essex County and Jersey City in Hudson County for both electric and gas. JCP&L serves much of the central and shore area, and Atlantic City Electric serves southern New Jersey, so check the name on your electric bill. If your bill says something else, see the JCP&L page or the Atlantic City Electric page.

The heat pump programs require you to own the house where the work happens. They cover single-family and attached homes of one to four units, and they exclude new construction and commercial property. Rebates are credited as a deduction on the contractor's invoice, not on your bill. The large replacement rebates apply to gas or delivered fuel customers who take the old system out of service, which means a form and sometimes photos. Heat pumps must be sized to the home with a written heating load calculation.

The repayment option lets qualified customers pay for work in equal parts on the PSE&G bill with no interest. The limit is $25,000 for an HVAC project, $50,000 for a stand-alone decarbonization project and $75,000 when the two are combined. You need 12 months of on-time payment history, though a letter from a previous utility can substitute. PSE&G says it does not run a credit check. Terms are 84 months, or 84 or 120 months for income-qualified customers on projects over $10,000.

We did not find a PSE&G rebate for rooftop solar, insulation as a stand-alone rebate (outside the free programs) or windows. State solar credits and net metering still apply to solar owners. The federal credits ended after 2025, and the state's federal-funded home rebates have no launch we could find.
claim_heading: How to claim a PSE&G rebate
claim_steps: Confirm your electric or gas bill says PSE&G.
For heating, cooling and water heaters, choose a participating contractor from PSE&G's program page or call 1-855-846-2895.
Ask for a quote that shows each rebate line and any removal work.
For appliances, buy the model and apply online within 120 days with the receipt.
Keep invoices, model numbers and photos.

faq: How much does PSE&G pay for a heat pump?
$300 to $600 for a standard heat pump, and up to $10,000 (or $12,000 for income-qualified homes) to replace a gas, oil or propane heating system.
Do I have to own my home?
Yes. The HVAC and decarbonization programs require the owner of the house where the work is done.
Does PSE&G pay for a battery?
Yes. GridSmart pays up to $5,000, for new installs of three approved batteries, in return for letting PSE&G use the battery up to 100 times a year.
Yes. Interest-free on-bill repayment of up to $25,000, $50,000 or $75,000 depending on the project.
Can the rebate go on my bill?
No. PSE&G credits HVAC and battery rebates only as a deduction on the contractor's invoice.
